c.tagline: Rhineland powerhouse of a soaring cathedral, Kolsch and Carnival.

taxi.fareNote: Fares are metered and regulated; Free Now and Uber dispatch the same licensed taxis, so prices are broadly similar and there is little street-hailing outside ranks and stations.

emergency.note: 112 reaches ambulance and fire across the EU; 110 is the direct police line.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: Pickpockets work the Hauptbahnhof, cathedral square and Ringe nightlife strip; keep valuables close late at night around the station and Ebertplatz.

hood_desc: The historic core on the Rhine's left bank, dominated by the twin-spired Gothic Cathedral, the Old Town lanes, riverside promenade, breweries and the main museums; the obvious first-timer base.
Cologne's most stylish quarter (Belgisches Viertel), a grid of independent boutiques, design shops, coffee bars and buzzing nightlife around Brusseler Platz and Friesenplatz.
A multicultural, creative district west of the center famous for street art, live-music venues, Turkish and Balkan food and an unpretentious bar and club scene.
A charming, village-like southern quarter (Severinsviertel) of cozy Kolsch pubs, cafes and small squares, with the medieval Severinstorburg gate at its heart.
A modern district across the Rhine built around the Koelnmesse trade fair, the Lanxess Arena and Bahnhof Deutz, with the city's best postcard views back to the cathedral.
lodging: Hotel Mondial am Dom Cologne - MGallery

water.note: Tap water is safe and strictly regulated.

transit.hours: The Stadtbahn and S-Bahn run roughly 4am-1am, with several lines running all night on Friday and Saturday; night buses fill the gaps midweek.
transit.pay: No transit card needed: buy tickets in the KVB app or from station and on-board machines (bank cards accepted) and keep them for inspection. A single ride in the city is about 3.20 EUR (~US$3.50) and a day ticket around 8 EUR on the VRS tariff; one ticket covers the Stadtbahn, S-Bahn and buses. Staying weeks? The Deutschland-Ticket (58 EUR/month) covers local transit nationwide.

transit.m: S-Bahn S19 or S13 to Hauptbahnhof (~15 min)

tip.r: 5-10% / round up the bill for good service
